title: How do financial and commodity markets volatility react to real economic activity?
summary: The paper tests lead-lag links and integration between real economic activity and financial and commodity market volatility. Real activity shocks co-move with these markets, but the markets led that co-movement during downturns such as the COVID-19 pandemic.
keyFindings: Real economic activity shocks co-move with financial and commodity market volatility.
The markets led the co-movement during downturns such as COVID-19.
Connectedness is stronger during downturns and over the long run.
methods: Discrete wavelet analysis of lead-lag links and a time-varying parameter VAR with stochastic volatility.
